text: Customize the app's appearance with new theme presets and per-mode accent colors. A single unified navigation bar with a retractable desktop sidebar. Text Commands now support trigger aliases, and bot cards show the real icons of your Discord servers. Hosted Apps are now Ready-Made Bots for one-click launches, and the code editor returns with full customization and a Rose Pine theme by default. Faster home screen thanks to server and image caching, bundled Google Fonts, and a console that matches the logs page. Fixed cloud sync so your local bots and commands are preserved, fixed duplicate command names breaking sync, corrected reaction/permission functions, and translated remaining hardcoded strings across all languages.
